list.name: Framework Core

list.name: Helpers & Utilities
list.description: Cross-cutting utilities under helao/helpers: config loading, logging, the async HTTP dispatcher, premodels, and YAML/HLO/parquet/zmq helpers shared by every server.

list.name: Hardware Drivers

list.name: Action & Visualizer Servers

list.name: Experiment & Sequence Library
list.description: Importable experiment, sequence, specification, processor, and layout definitions for the HTE deployment that the orchestrator dynamically loads per config.

list.name: Configuration
list.description: Station orchestration-group YAMLs, conda environment specs, and tool config files that define server groups and the build/runtime environment.

list.name: Testing
list.description: Unit-test runners and standalone test/dry-run scripts under core/tests and the deployment, including the model unit test and per-driver/server test scripts.
